input.overview: In Star Light, completing S-T-A-R lights the right eject hole for the lock, while the ten numbered star rollovers build constellation value. Shoot the lit eject hole to lock the ball; the served ball's first playfield switch begins two-ball Multiball with double scoring. Complete L-I-G-H-T to raise the spinner from 1,000 to 2,000, and use the lit ADV X target or orbit to raise Bonus X. Completing both S-T-A-R and L-I-G-H-T lights Bonus Holdover; on the final ball that same award becomes timed Bonus Time.
input.simpleOverview: Complete S-T-A-R, then shoot the lit right eject hole to lock a ball; the next served ball starts two-ball Multiball on its first playfield switch, with scoring doubled. Light all ten numbered stars for constellations, complete L-I-G-H-T to raise the spinner, and complete both words to light Bonus Holdover.
input.summary: Start Multiball through S-T-A-R and the right eject hole, while using lane change to finish missing numbered stars. Build L-I-G-H-T and Bonus X between lock attempts so the same controlled shots improve spinner and end-of-ball value.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the lit right eject hole, then register a switch with the served ball.

steps.text: Complete the S-T-A-R standups to light the right eject hole for a ball lock.
Shoot the lit right eject hole; after the replacement ball is served, its first playfield switch starts two-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, keep balls moving through the spinner and numbered star rollovers while all scoring is doubled.
Use the separate right-side lane-change button to steer top-lane feeds toward missing numbered stars.

alternatives.title: Constellation and spinner route
alternatives.when: Use this while S-T-A-R is incomplete or the right eject hole is rejecting shots.

steps.text: Light all ten numbered stars to complete a constellation and add 10,000 to its base value.
Complete L-I-G-H-T to light the spinner for 1,000; later completions raise it to 2,000 while flashing.
Hit the currently lit ADV X feature to raise Bonus X before draining.
Complete both S-T-A-R and L-I-G-H-T to light the right lane for Bonus Holdover.
On the final ball, collect the same lit lane for timed Bonus Time: one second per star plus ten seconds per constellation.

machineSetup: Test the S-T-A-R and L-I-G-H-T standups, right eject hole and lock, both trough switches, spinner, ten numbered star rollovers, ADV X features, and right-side holdover lane.
Confirm that the separate cabinet lane-change button works independently of the flippers and that the final-ball holdover award starts timed Bonus Time rather than another normal ball.

playfieldReferences.description: Right-side hole that locks the ball and leads into two-ball Multiball.

playfieldReferences.description: Central rollover array used to complete constellations.

playfieldReferences.label: L-I-G-H-T standups
playfieldReferences.description: Five targets that raise the lit spinner value.

playfieldReferences.label: ADV X feature
playfieldReferences.description: Roving lit target or orbit that raises Bonus X.

playfieldReferences.label: Right Bonus Holdover lane
playfieldReferences.description: Lane that collects Bonus Holdover or final-ball Bonus Time when lit.

cautions.issue: Lane change uses a separate cabinet button.
cautions.response: Do not assume a flipper press rotates the top lanes; test and use the dedicated right-side button before the ball reaches them.
